theorems.name: Submission.cmr_null_of_compact_null
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → ν C = 0 → μ C = 0) → ∀ E : Set (Euclid P), ν E = 0 → μ E = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
